shared_elements: repeating ornamental pattern covering a band/register
justification: A is wholly non-figural, covered with dense hatched chevron/herringbone panels, while B shows a narrative figural scene of harnessed horses in profile drawing a spoked-wheel chariot with a driver, bounded below by a row of rosettes. The only correspondence is the generic presence of repeating ornament organised in a band, which any tradition could produce independently; there is no shared subject, figure or relationship.
